behaviour.title: Clear the pinned sample data before going live
behaviour.detail: "Hourly Schedule" carries pinned sample data, which is what lets the workflow run end to end before you have wired anything up. While it is pinned, a manual execution reads the sample and never calls the real service - so the run succeeds and proves nothing about your setup. Unpin it once the credentials and bindings are in place.

bindings.title: Import "lib: Research Specialist" and select it on Research Specialist (Sub-workflow)
bindings.detail: This template calls a separate workflow named lib: Research Specialist, and it is included in your download as lib/lib-research-specialist.json. Import that file into n8n first (Workflows -> Import from File), then open Research Specialist (Sub-workflow) and pick it in the workflowId selector. The selector is empty until you do: a workflow id only exists inside your own instance, so it cannot be set for you.

behaviour.title: Set a real fallback for the placeholder expressions
behaviour.detail: "YOUR_PROJECT_GID", "YOUR_WORKSPACE_GID" appears as the fallback branch of an expression. When the upstream field is missing the expression does not fail - it resolves to that literal string and the call is made with it, which reads downstream as a malformed value rather than as missing data.

behaviour.title: Set the environment variables, or inline the values
behaviour.detail: This template reads $env.ASANA_PROJECT_GID, $env.ASANA_WORKSPACE_GID. Environment variables are not exposed to expressions on n8n Cloud at all, and on self-hosted they are unset until you add them - in both cases the expression falls through to its literal fallback rather than erroring, so the call is made against a placeholder.
